title: Finite affine pro-étale covers admit compatible étale Čech approximations
statement: Let Y be an affine scheme, V an affine ind-étale Y-object, and U_a→V a Fin n-indexed pro-étale covering such that every nonempty repeated intersection is affine ind-étale over Y [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis]. There exist a small cofiltered category I and an AffineEtaleCechSystem [def-cbc-affine-etale-cech-system] for this family such that every nerveCone is a limit after forgetting to schemes. No coefficients or cocycles are involved.

source.place: Tag 099U, condition (3), finite Čech limit reductions; Tags 099T, 01ZM, 01ZN and 07RP. The proof also uses the explicitly named, already proved WeilConjectures and Mathlib declarations.

proof.text: The singleton-product isomorphism identifies each original member with its one-factor nerve term. Transport proAffineEtale across its inverse to obtain the member hypotheses.
Apply the finite-family covering presentation theorem with the original indexing.
Construct the system using systemOfPresentation. Apply presentedNerveIsLimit to the provided base and member limit cones for each degree and tuple.

theorem exists_affine_etale_cech_system
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y]
    (V : Y.ProEt) (hV : proAffineEtale V.hom)
    {n : ℕ} (U : Fin n → Over V)
    (hU : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n),
      proAffineEtale (Presheaf.cechNerveObj U y).left.hom)
    (hcover : Sieve.ofArrows (fun a ↦ (U a).left) (fun a ↦ (U a).hom) ∈
      Scheme.ProEt.topology Y V) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsCofiltered I)
      (S : AffineEtaleCechSystem Y V U I),
      ∀ k y, Nonempty (IsLimit
        ((Scheme.ProEt.forget Y ⋙ Over.forget Y).mapCone (S.nerveCone k y)))
